race.comment: HELL'S DIAMOND (5) impressed when successful as favourite on debut over 1207m at Kilmore five-and-a-half months ago and has not been produced since. Should continue to progress into her 4yo season and looks set to remain unbeaten. KOOLATAH QUEEN (9) lines up for the first time since May 24 having contested a stronger race at Ballarat. Has jumped out well recently and should take holding out. THIS IS THE MOMENT (8) was narrowly beaten at his latest appearance at this track over 1590m 11 weeks ago. Has switched to the John Rooney stable, betting will be key for the new yard but he could be a blowout hope at odds. TITAN OF CHOICE (1) was just fair last time at Pakenham Synthetic. Now with the Ben Brisbourne yard and his best is good enough.
